 Today’s Best Deals: Cheap PS5 SSDs, 007 First Light for $35, and a $128 50" Vizio 4K QLED Smart TV
 Save on Saros, LEGO, a Zelda brain teaser and more, too.
 This post might contain affiliation links. If you buy something through this post, the publisher may get a share of the sale. 
 By   Danielle Abraham   
 Updated: Nov. 13, 2026, 3 a.m. 
 Related reads: MapleStorySEA Celebrates 20th Anniversary With Massive Summer Updates 
 Part one of Walmart’s Black Friday sale is live, bringing incredible deals on PS5 SSDs, LEGO, Zelda brain teasers, and more.  PlayStation has also dropped a digital copy of 007 First Light to just $34.99, and you can get a Saros PS5 disc for $20 off. Plus, Nintendo posted discounts to look for during its Black Friday sale , which begins November 22. Check out those deals and many more below:  TL;DR - The Best Deals for November 12
 Cheap PS5 SSDs
 More like this Open Back Headphones: A Sound Experience Like No Other Storage prices are ridiculous these days. If you’re looking for a cheap SSD to throw in your PS5, Walmart has the best deal going. The Verbatim 1TB or 2TB SSD is a PS5-compatible PCIe Gen4 x4 SSD with an M.2 2280 form factor and an aluminum heatsink installed–a must for the PS5’s toasty slot. Both also far exceed the console’s minimum sequential read-speed requirements, hitting up to 7,000MB/s. For added peace of mind, both drives even come with a 2-year limited warranty. 
 007 First Light for PS5 Is $34.99
 It might not be a physical copy, but this deal might be too good to pass up. 007 First Light is down to just $34.99 during PlayStation’s Black Friday Sale . That’s an incredible deal on this action-adventure game that serves as a reimagined origin story of James Bond. In IGN’s 007 First Light review , the game earned a 9/10 rating, with Luke Reilly stating, “Patiently paced, First Light is brimming with Bond’s trinity of gadgets, guns, and girls in a way that feels fresh but reverent, and never like parody.”  Save $20 on a Saros PS5 Disc
 A physical copy of Saros for PlayStation 5 is down to $20 at Amazon and Walmart. And the game is all on the disc, so you won’t need to worry about additional downloads. This third-person bullet-hell shooter with roguelite-level structure from Housemarque dropped in April and really tests your skills. In IGN’s Saros review , Michael Higham found the game “tries an interesting and ambitious story it isn't always able to effectively tell, but Housemarque has once again proved that its bullet-hell sensibilities mesh incredibly well with fluid and challenging action.” $128 VIZIO 50" 4K QLED Smart TV
 If you just want a cheap 4K TV, the VIZIO 50" 4K QLED Smart TV is only $128 as an early Black Friday deal at Walmart. It’s a killer price for a QLED TV that’s great for a bedroom or game room. It even packs Quantum Dot technology for stunning colors and has VIZIO OS built-in for easy access to your favorite streaming platforms and more.  $28 LEGO Poinsettia
 Poinsettias are a signature holiday plant, but who has time to water them? Instead, you can pick up a LEGO Poinsettia Plant for just $28. It will last much longer than a real plant, and you get the enjoyment of building it too. In total, there are 608 pieces, with the final plant measuring over 8” high, 8.5” wide, and 6.5” deep. The leaves and flowers are even posable so that you can get the perfect look for your space.  Zelda Metal Brain Teaser Is Only $12.88
 The Legend of Zelda TriforceHanayama Metal Brain Teasers is down to just $12.88. This Mensa-rated brain teasers is great for anyone who wants a fun mental challenge, and when you’re not playing with it, it'll look incredible on a desk. The build quality is top-notch, made of cast metal, ensuring it will last a long time. It even makes a great stocking stuffer for a Zelda fan in your life.  Get an Obsession 4K Blu-ray for $12.99
 The 4K Collector's Edition Blu-ray of Obsession is down to just $12.99 on Amazon and Walmart. This movie was a box office smash, and you can add it to your physical media collection for cheap. It follows a guy with a crush on a girl who makes a wish on a One Wish Willow, so she’ll like him. Unsurprisingly, things go awry, and it gets dark. Beyond the 4K UHD, you get a standard Blu-ray and digital copy plus a few bonus features.  $80 Off the Talix Fluxo 7-in-1 Desktop Charging Station
 Add some flash to your desk with the Talix Fluxo GAN 7-in-1 Desktop Charging Station . Use the coupon code “JUSCBRQU” to save $80 at checkout. Its unique design features a sharp two-tone black-and-silver colorway with illuminated ringed power outlets that can be rotated through six different colors. For connectivity, three AC outlets rated for up to 2,500W total, two 140W USB-C ports, a 45W USB-C port, and a 30W USB Type-A port, making it ideal for work or gaming setups.  The Ghost in the Shell Legacy Edition Manga Box Set Hits New Low
 The Ghost in the Shell Legacy Edition Manga Box Set has dropped to its lowest price on Amazon. The original Japanese cyberpunk comic series by Masamune Shirow has its edited pages restored. Plus, the Deluxe Edition localizations of The Ghost in the Shell 1.5: Human Error Processor and The Ghost in the Shell 2.0: Man-Machine Interface are also included. Each series is bound in hardcover and comes in a premium slipcase with new illustrations from Shirow. That’s not all, as 11 exclusive posters and a set of multicolored Fuchikoma robot stickers come with this box set. Check out even more early Black Friday manga deals on Amazon below: Pokémon TCG Invite Requests
 It’s back; you can request an invite to purchase the Pokémon TCG: 30th Celebration Elite Trainer Box for $59.99 on Amazon. That’s well below the market value, which is sitting around twice that amount. If you still want the ETB and don’t want to pay a fortune, it’s worth a shot. Even if you’re selected, you don’t have to buy. Keep checking your email; if selected, you'll have 72 hours to purchase. You can also enter a drawing at Target to get the 30th Celebration Booster Bundle for MSRP.  Pokémon TCG: Mega Evolution - Delta Reign dropped, and you can score a Booster Box at MSRP. You just need to request an invite at Best Buy now and a free Best Buy account to make the request. If selected, you’ll have 24 hours to make the purchase. The box includes 36 booster packs for $160.99, making each just $4.47, a steal in this market. $30 Off a 4-Pack of Apple AirTags (2nd Gen)
 A four-pack of Apple AirTags (2nd Generation) is back down to their lowest price ever. These handy little tracking devices can live in luggage, on keys, or even on a pet. The AirTag pairs easily with an iPhone or iPad and connects seamlessly with Apple’s Find My app. Location sharing even lets your family and friends track certain items, too. This newest generation features improved precision finding, a louder speaker, the ability to ping from farther away, and more. As someone who constantly misplaces things, AirTags are a lifesaver. Get $5 Off The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time for Switch 2
 You can pick up a digital copy of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time on Switch 2 for $5 off on Newegg. To score this deal on the incredibly popular game that dropped last week, enter the promo code “EMCF3483” at checkout. You’ll receive a redemption code for the game shortly after purchase. In IGN’s review, Ocarina of Time earned an “Amazing” 9/10 rating . Logan Plant found, "Nintendo skillfully melds the world and dungeon design of classic Zeldas with the movement and presentation of its more recent games, creating both a beautiful retelling of a legend and a rich adventure that stands on its own." Save $18 on a LEGO Up-Scaled Santa Minifigure
 If you’re looking to add some festive decor to your home, this LEGO Up-Scaled Santa Minifigure adds the perfect amount of holiday cheer. As the name suggests, this build looks like a minifigure, just bigger, measuring over 10.5 inches tall. The 761 pieces create a classic Santa complete with a bold red ensemble, signature hat, and white beard. Right now, this set is at its lowest price yet on Amazon, saving you $18.  3 Months of Audible for $0.99/month + $20 Audible Credit
 Amazon has brought back its incredible Audible discount as an early Black Friday deal . New and returning subscribers can get three months of an Audible Standard subscription for just $0.99 per month and a $20 bonus Audible Credit. After that period, the price returns to $8.99. With a Standard subscription, you get access to the same catalog of millions of books as Premium Plus subscribers. Each month you get one audiobook that remains in your library as long as you keep your membership. Best of all, you don’t even need to be a Prime member to score this deal. $70 Off the Logitech G PRO X Superlight 2 SE Gaming Mouse
 The red Logitech G PRO X Superlight 2 SE Gaming Mouse is just $69 at Walmart. It’s an incredibly lightweight gaming mouse with an advanced optical sensor that tracks over 888+ IPS and up to 44,000 DPI. The switches are precise and reliable, and the 88-hour battery with USB-C charging is a nice addition. Read IGN’s full review of the Logitech G PRO X Superlight 2 to learn more; it’s nearly identical to the SE model but offers an 8,000Hz polling rate instead of 1,000Hz. 40% Off the LEGO Phantom Menace Battle Droid with STAP
 The LEGO Phantom Menace Battle Droid with STAP is 40% off, matching its Prime Big Deal days and all-time low pricing. This build features 1,088 pieces and is bigger than you’d expect, measuring over 15 inches. Once finished, a display stand, complete with a cute mini droid, lets you show off your build on a shelf or desk. MTG x Star Trek Play Booster Box Preorder Drops to New Low
 The MTG x Star Trek Play Booster Box preorder has just dropped to its lowest price yet on Amazon. For just $124.99, you’ll get 30 Play Boosters, bringing each to just $4.17. MTG’s latest Universes Beyond set is out later this week, but if the price drops further before then, Amazon offers an awesome preorder guarantee.  50% Off Criterion Collection 4K Blu-rays
 The Criterion Collection Early Black Friday Sale has dropped 4K Blu-ray prices by 50%. Cinephiles will want to jump on these physical media deals while you can because the most popular films and collections may sell out. Guillermo del Toro’s Frankenstein starring Oscar Isaac and Jacob Elordi, the incredibly popular animated movie KPop Demon Hunters, and even Godzilla: The Showa-Era Films are all discounted.
